compiled_state.title: Flip enforcement.strategy=ci and reconcile CLAUDE.md rule 18
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- DD1: End-to-end PR-mode merge pre-validation (the Batch 1 merge of Tasks 1+2 via PR serves as pre-validation — this task's batch merge is the FIRST commit through PR mode after the flip)
- DD2: dso-config.conf has enforcement.strategy=ci; both hook layers emit HOOK_GATE: skipped when ci strategy is set
- DD3: CLAUDE.md rule 18 reconciled with ci-strategy semantics in same commit as the flip

## Description

After confirming required-checks.txt alignment and Tasks 1+2 have proven PR-mode works on this repo, perform the operational flip:

### Step 1: Pre-flight required-checks validation
Run validate-required-checks.sh and confirm exit 0:
```bash
bash plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/validate-required-checks.sh
```
If it exits non-zero, add missing check names to .github/required-checks.txt and re-run until it passes.

### Step 2: Edit .claude/dso-config.conf
Change:
```
enforcement.strategy=local
```
To:
```
enforcement.strategy=ci
```

### Step 3: Reconcile CLAUDE.md rule 18 (MINIMAL, TARGETED)
Rule 18 currently ends with: "Rationalizing around it (e.g., 'these are just docs', 'this is trivial') is exactly the failure mode this gate prevents."

Add ONE sentence after the current rule 18 text:
"Exception: when enforcement.strategy=ci, the PreToolUse hook (review-gate.sh via bypass-sentinel) emits HOOK_GATE: skipped and returns 0 before evaluating bypass vectors — under ci strategy, --no-verify and other bypass patterns are not blocked locally (CI enforces via the parity-uplifted llm-review job)."

**CLAUDE.md constraint**: Keep this change to ONE sentence. Do not add sub-bullets, new rules, or new sections. The existing rule 18 text is not modified — only this sentence is appended. This satisfies the bloat-review criterion (rule amendment, not new content).

### Step 4: In-session verification
After editing both files, verify both hook layers short-circuit with ci strategy:

Pre-commit layer (already implemented):
```bash
TMPDIR_V=$(mktemp -d /tmp/verify-config.XXXXXX)
cp .claude/dso-config.conf "$TMPDIR_V/"
WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$TMPDIR_V/dso-config.conf" bash plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh 2>&1 | grep HOOK_GATE
rm -rf "$TMPDIR_V"
```

PreToolUse layer (newly implemented by Task 2):
```bash
TMPDIR_V2=$(mktemp -d /tmp/verify-pretooluse.XXXXXX)
cp .claude/dso-config.conf "$TMPDIR_V2/"
RESULT=$(WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$TMPDIR_V2/dso-config.conf" bash -c "
    source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh
    hook_review_bypass_sentinel '{\"tool_name\":\"Bash\",\"tool_input\":{\"command\":\"git commit --no-verify -m test\"}}'
    echo exit:\$?
" 2>&1); rm -rf "$TMPDIR_V2"
echo "$RESULT"
# Expected: HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci AND exit:0
```

Both must produce: "HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] .claude/dso-config.conf has enforcement.strategy=ci
  Verify: grep -q 'enforcement.strategy=ci' .claude/dso-config.conf
- [ ] validate-required-checks.sh passes (exit 0)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/validate-required-checks.sh
- [ ] CLAUDE.md rule 18 has ci-strategy exception sentence
  Verify: grep -q 'enforcement.strategy=ci.*--no-verify.*not blocked locally\|ci strategy.*--no-verify.*not blocked' CLAUDE.md
- [ ] Pre-commit hook emits HOOK_GATE:skipped with ci config
  Verify: TMPDIR_V=$(mktemp -d /tmp/verify-hook.XXXXXX); cp .claude/dso-config.conf "$TMPDIR_V/"; RESULT=$(WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$TMPDIR_V/dso-config.conf" bash plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh 2>&1 || true); rm -rf "$TMPDIR_V"; echo "$RESULT" | grep -q "HOOK_GATE: skipped"
- [ ] PreToolUse hook emits HOOK_GATE:skipped with ci config
  Verify: TMPDIR_V2=$(mktemp -d /tmp/verify-hook2.XXXXXX); cp .claude/dso-config.conf "$TMPDIR_V2/"; RESULT=$(WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$TMPDIR_V2/dso-config.conf" bash -c "source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh; hook_review_bypass_sentinel '{\"tool_name\":\"Bash\",\"tool_input\":{\"command\":\"git commit --no-verify -m test\"}}'" 2>&1 || true); rm -rf "$TMPDIR_V2"; echo "$RESULT" | grep -q "HOOK_GATE: skipped"
